messages:
maya: Anyone up for a gear swap + quick bouldering sesh at CityWall after work tonight? Got an extra pair of 5.10 shoes (EU42) and a tiny crash pad I can bring.

sam: I’m in if we start around 6:30. need to run an errand before.

jordan: brought chalk and tape — will show up. can someone belay? (I’ll top-rope too if people prefer) :chalk: :muscle:

alex: I can belay for a bit. also doing 4x800m on the track earlier so might be a bit slow on routes 😅

ciara: Ooh gear swap—do you have a size 39 shoe by any chance? I’m between sizes and always tempted to test.

maya: only a 42 this time, sorry! but I’ll bring an extra harness (medium) and a couple of draws.

run-bot: Logged run for alex: 4.1mi @ 7:45/mi, 18:02 total — nice tempo. :running_man: (auto-post)

sam: also curious — anyone want to do a short lap before climbing? 2-3 miles easy, then boulder. warms me up.

jordan: yes please. meet at 5:15 at the fountain? quick out-and-back, then CityWall by 6:30.

alex: works for me. bringing a headlamp just in case it runs long.

ciara: I’ll come for the climbing part only. can we gate the swap items with a quick list so no chaos?

maya: good call. my list: 5.10 shoes EU42, small crash pad, medium harness, couple of slings. everything in decent condition.

sam: I have a pair of climbing shoes that have too much toe room, size 41. and a chalk bag with a half-full block.

jordan: cool. I’ll take any pads off your hands if you need to clear space, maya.

alex: tiny poll — prefer routes or problems tonight? reply with :one: for routes (top-rope) or :two: for problems (bouldering).

maya: :two: bouldering. short and spicy.

ciara: :one: I’m rusty, want routes to warm back in.

sam: :two: boulder for me.

jordan: :two: all the way.

alex: split preference noted — we’ll do a mix. light routes first then a few problems. plan: 5:15 run meet, 6:30 CityWall.

maya: tagging @ciara for the shoe size Q — see you all later. :wave:

run-bot: Reminder: Group run scheduled in thread at 5:15 (auto-reminder).

sam: anyone grabbing coffee beforehand? I need fuel.

ciara: I will. bringing a spare Clif bar for whoever needs it.

alex: cheers — see you at the fountain!
